title: CombAlgebra
html:
定义组：System F 固定组合代数与 PER 语义。有序参数：D、ap、k、s。

精确含义以本页公式体及其全部依赖为准。

规范公式

(@ CombAlgebra D ap k s) 按 无捕获缩写规则 展开为下列有限公式。参数只取集合，不能填入函数项或元语言公式。

(and
  (@ Nonempty D)
  (and
    (@ TotalApplication D ap)
    (and
      (in k D)
      (and
        (in s D)
        (and
          (forall x
            (implies
              (in x D)
              (forall y (implies (in y D) (exists kx (and (@ AlgebraApp ap k x kx) (@ AlgebraApp ap kx y x)))))))
          (forall x
            (implies
              (in x D)
              (forall y
                (implies
                  (in y D)
                  (forall z
                    (implies
                      (in z D)
                      (exists sx
                        (exists sxy
                          (exists lhs
                            (exists xz
                            (exists yz
                            (exists rhs
                            (and
                            (@ AlgebraApp ap s x sx)
                            (and
                            (@ AlgebraApp ap sx y sxy)
                            (and
                            (@ AlgebraApp ap sxy z lhs)
                            (and
                            (@ AlgebraApp ap x z xz)
                            (and (@ AlgebraApp ap y z yz) (and (@ AlgebraApp ap xz yz rhs) (= lhs rhs))))))))))))))))))))))))

直接依赖

AlgebraApp；Nonempty；TotalApplication
